study: Blinded eBOSS DR16 LRG full-catalogue source/header and published veto/sector-semantics gate
stage: official literature and immutable source/header metadata only; no catalogue rows or MANGLE evaluation
source_headers_only: Exactly 2880-byte HTTP 206 Content-Range requests from file beginning through primary and first BINTABLE END cards. Refuse HTTP 200 full-body fallback. No FITS table-row request; record bounded header SHA256 and candidate sector/completeness column names.

published_references.title: Ross et al. (2020), MNRAS 498, 2354, Sections 5.2 and 5.4, Table 2
facts: LRG candidate post-veto sector quality C_eBOSS > 0.5 and C_z > 0.5; exact boundary is strict in the paper
LRG collision-priority veto is distinct from QSO collision-priority veto (QSO collision only QSO in Table 2)
LRG veto categories include collision priority, bad field, bright star, infrared bright star, bright object, centrepost; numeric area columns overlap
C_eBOSS used to weight rather than independently subsample released random catalogue

published_references.title: Zhao et al. (2021), MNRAS 503, 1149, Section 2.3.2
facts: Matched mock sector trim described with C_eBOSS > 0.5, C_z > 0.5 for LRG/QSO; ELG different thresholds
LRG MANGLE and ELG brickmask represent different tracer-specific input windows

caution: Exact mapping of IR/optical bright-star filenames to LRG veto categories and official sector polygon weight/completeness rules requires production provenance. Listed files do not imply union or hard-cut. COMP_BOSS, sector_TSR and sector_SSR are only candidate column names until verified from the official LRG header and official release definitions.
